about.title: I know agencies from the inside. With and without a network.
paragraphs: Fifteen years agency-side, in network and independent agencies — from account management to leading client service teams. I've run QBRs, taken over escalations, defended budgets and rebuilt more than one relationship that had quietly gone cold.

What I learned along the way: networks know how to keep money and clients under control, and lose it in their own bureaucracy. Independent agencies often do the better work and lose the money somewhere between clients, hours and gut feeling. I know both sides, and which 20 % of network practice is worth it.

steps.title: Numbers and conversations
steps.body: You give me access to revenue, costs and hours for the last twelve months. I talk to you and, if you like, to two or three people from the team.

steps.body: Profit per client, dependencies, where time disappears and how much of it nobody pays for.

items.title: Your biggest client is also your most expensive.
items.body: Revenue looks great, margin doesn't. Nobody knows how many hours really go in — or whether it still pays.

items.title: The renewal turns into a pitch.
items.body: The work was strong, the reports went out, and still the client is “reviewing options”. Nobody saw it coming, because nobody was clearly running the relationship.

items.title: The work is good. Everything else is chaos.
items.body: Priorities change daily, budgets are guessed rather than set, and everything important ends up on your desk.

sections.heading: HOSTING AND SERVER LOG FILES
lines: This site is served via GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA). When you access it, technically necessary connection data is processed: IP address, date and time, the file requested, browser type and operating system.

The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR — my legitimate interest in operating the site securely and reliably. Transfer to the USA is based on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses and the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

sections.heading: GOOGLE ANALYTICS 4
lines: With your consent I use Google Analytics 4, a service of Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland. It sets cookies and collects pseudonymised usage data: pages viewed, time on page, approximate location, device type, referrer, and individual interactions (clicks on email links, social links, navigation links and the EN/DE language toggle).
IP anonymisation is enabled; your IP address is truncated before storage. No merging with other data and no advertising personalisation takes place.
The legal basis is your consent under Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR together with § 25 (1) TDDDG. Without consent no analytics cookie is set and no event is transmitted.

Transfer to Google LLC in the USA cannot be ruled out. Google LLC is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, supplemented by the EU Standard Contractual Clauses. There remains a risk that US authorities access the data without effective legal remedies being available.
Retention period: 14 months. Further information: https://policies.google.com/privacy

sections.heading: COOKIES AND LOCAL STORAGE
lines: Your choice in the cookie banner is stored locally in your browser (local storage, key "shruggie-consent") so the banner is not shown on every visit. This entry contains no personal data and is not transmitted to me.

sections.heading: CONTACT FORM AND EMAIL
lines: If you write to me via the contact form, I process your name, email address, message and, if given, company and phone number. If you contact me by email, I process the details in your email. Both are used only to handle your enquiry.

The legal basis is your consent under Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR (contact form), or Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR for contract-related enquiries, otherwise Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. You can withdraw your consent at any time by email.

Enquiries sent via the form are stored in my Client Workspace (Supabase, data centre in Frankfurt, Germany; delivered via Cloudflare in the EU). I am notified of new enquiries by email via Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, Paris). Data processing agreements under Art. 28 GDPR are in place with all of these providers.
Your enquiry is deleted once it has been dealt with and no statutory retention periods apply; if it does not lead to an engagement, at the latest twelve months after our last communication.
